title: Tool inputs
description: Each entry in $defs is one tool's inputSchema. Every schema is flat (FR-048): string, integer and boolean fields, enums and optional fields only, and unknown fields are rejected. A rule between fields is checked by the bridge, which answers INVALID_ARGUMENT.

location_id.description: The location. Omitted: the owned location when there is exactly one; otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT, with the location ids in details.

get_overview.title: get_overview input
get_overview.description: Scope: read. The home in one reply: alarm mode, open contacts, active motion, offline devices, low batteries and bridge health, within about 8,000 tokens.

location_id.description: The location. Omitted: the owned location when there is exactly one; otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT, with the location ids in details.

room.description: Only devices in this room, matched against the room Ring assigns.

list_devices.title: list_devices input
list_devices.description: Scope: read. Devices with id, name, type, room, battery level, power mode and online status, filterable by type and room.

device_id.description: The device id, as list_devices returns it (id) or an event names it (device.id). Unknown: NOT_FOUND.

get_device.title: get_device input
get_device.description: Scope: read. The full state of one device.

get_health.title: get_health input
get_health.description: Scope: read. The bridge's own health: the home link, the Ring session, push reception, the last event received, and since when data has been stale. Takes no input.
